column_desc: Date the ads ran and their results were counted (format: YYYY-MM-DD, period: 2025-09-01 to 2025-09-30). One row is one day of ad results for one Date, Media and Product; every Date x Media x Product combination has exactly one row (4 media x 6 products x 30 days = 720 rows, no duplicates, no missing rows)
Media where the ad ran and the product was sold (Kuppang, Neiba, Amazon, Kulsam)
Product category, fixed per product (Convenience Food: Instant Rice Set, Frozen Dumplings; Health Food: Protein Bar, Omega-3; Fresh Food: Salad Kit, Premium Fruit)
Name of the advertised product (Instant Rice Set, Frozen Dumplings, Protein Bar, Omega-3, Salad Kit, Premium Fruit)
Number of times this row's ad (Date, Media, Product) was shown
Number of clicks on this row's ad
Number of purchases (orders) made after clicking this row's ad
Ad spend of this row (unit: KRW)
Total paid amount of this row's conversions (purchases after an ad click) (unit: KRW). Sales that did not come through an ad are not included
Click-through rate of this row (%) = Clicks / Impressions x 100, rounded to 2 decimals. CTR over several rows is SUM(Clicks) / SUM(Impressions) x 100
Conversion rate of this row (%) = Conversions / Clicks x 100, rounded to 2 decimals. Conversion rate over several rows is SUM(Conversions) / SUM(Clicks) x 100

Return on ad spend of this row = Revenue / Ad Cost, rounded to 2 decimals. A ratio, not a percent (3.50 = KRW 3.5 of revenue per KRW 1 of ad spend = 350%). ROAS over several rows is SUM(Revenue) / SUM(Ad Cost)
Age group that buys this product the most (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s). Fixed per product: the same whatever the Media or Date. It does not mean all of the row's revenue came from this age group
Gender that buys this product the most (Male, Female). Fixed per product: the same whatever the Media or Date. It does not mean all of the row's revenue came from this gender
